summary: On paper Denver has the edge (Denver's defense ranks 15th in explosive play rate, 8.2% allowed), while Arizona's best counter is to wrap up (Arizona's defense ranks 3rd in broken tackles per touch, 10.0% missed). Under center, Jacoby Brissett ranks 21st of 26 in EPA per dropback and Bo Nix ranks 22nd; x-factor: No receiver gets open like Jaylen Waddle (4.1 yards), and Arizona's pass defense ranks 23rd. The model favors Denver at 55%, mostly on passing matchup (1.4 pts) and offensive injuries (0.7 pts).
